elements.requirement: As soon as possible after the end of each financial year, the person appointed under section 127H(4) must prepare a report for that year.
elements.quote: As soon as possible after the end of each financial year, the person appointed under section 127H(4) must prepare a report for that year

elements.requirement: The first financial year is defined as the period beginning with the day on which section 56 of the Policing and Crime Act 2009 comes into force and ending with the next 31 March.
elements.quote: the period beginning with the day on which section 56 of the Policing and Crime Act 2009 comes into force and ending with the next 31 March (which is the first financial year)

elements.requirement: Each subsequent financial year is defined as each subsequent period of twelve months beginning with 1 April.
elements.quote: each subsequent period of twelve months beginning with 1 April

elements.requirement: The report must give the appointed person's opinion as to the circumstances and manner in which the powers conferred by sections 127C, 127D, 127E and 127F are being exercised in cases where the officer who exercised them is required to give a report under section 127H.
elements.quote: The report must give the appointed person's opinion as to the circumstances and manner in which the powers conferred by sections 127C, 127D, 127E and 127F are being exercised in cases where the officer who exercised them is required to give a report under section 127H

elements.requirement: The report prepared by the appointed person may make any recommendations that the appointed person considers appropriate.
elements.quote: The report may make any recommendations the appointed person considers appropriate

elements.requirement: The appointed person must send a copy of the report to the Scottish Ministers.
elements.quote: The appointed person must send a copy of the report to the Scottish Ministers

elements.requirement: The Scottish Ministers must publish any report received under section 127I(5).
elements.quote: publish any report received under subsection (5)

elements.requirement: The Scottish Ministers must lay a copy of any report received under section 127I(5) before the Scottish Parliament.
elements.quote: lay a copy before the Scottish Parliament

elements.requirement: Before publishing the report and laying a copy before the Scottish Parliament, the Scottish Ministers must exclude from the report any matter which the Scottish Ministers think is likely to prejudice any criminal investigation or criminal proceedings.
elements.quote: Before acting under subsection (6) the Scottish Ministers must exclude from the report any matter which the Scottish Ministers think is likely to prejudice any criminal investigation or criminal proceedings

elements.requirement: If the Scottish Ministers exclude any matter from the report, the Scottish Ministers must publish and lay before the Scottish Parliament the whole of the report as soon as they think that the excluded matter is no longer likely to prejudice any criminal investigation or criminal proceedings.
elements.quote: If the Scottish Ministers exclude any matter from the report they must comply with subsection (6) in relation to the whole of the report as soon as they think that the excluded matter is no longer likely to prejudice any criminal investigation or criminal proceedings
